English DepartmentEnglish Department
The English Department at comprises 18 dedicated members, including a Native-
English Teacher (NET). Our curriculum is designed to accommodate diverse learners,
offering tailored materials that address the needs of both advanced and less able students.
We implement experiential learning in junior forms, with F1 students learning English
through cooking classes, F2 students designing tote bags that are adorned with English
writing, and F3 students organizing game booths during lunchtime. With small class sizes
of around 20, our English teachers can provide undivided attention, ensuring that each
students՚ unique needs are met. Additionally, we offer supplementary classes on Saturdays
and after school to further support our students՚ learning journeys. This commitment to
individualized education fosters a nurturing environment where every student can thrive.
